nation.label: Nation
nation.description: The nation the pop is a part of

diseases.label: Diseases
diseases.description: The disease(s) this pop is currently infected with (empty = healthy). A pop can carry more than one disease at once — each applies its own job effects, cure rolls, and death rolls independently, as if the pop were working every disease's forced job simultaneously.

pre_disease_race.label: Pre-Disease Race
pre_disease_race.description: Race id restored once every one of this pop's diseases has been cured, for whichever disease was the one that changed its race
